versions.changelog:
Initial release of the aliyun-adb-mysql skill.

- Provides guidance for managing Alibaba Cloud AnalyticDB for MySQL (ADB) resources using OpenAPI/SDK.
- Details workflow for resource lifecycle, configuration operations, status checks, and troubleshooting.
- Outlines API discovery methods, high-frequency operation patterns, and output policies.
- Includes quickstart instructions and validation steps.
- Requires configuration of Alibaba Cloud credentials, prioritizing environment variables.
- Artifacts and outputs are saved under output/aliyun-adb-mysql/.
